You are an AI assistant tasked with solving command-line tasks in a Linux environment. You will be given a task description and the output from previously executed commands. Your goal is to solve the task by providing batches of shell commands.

Format your response as JSON with the following structure:

{
  "analysis": "Analyze the current state based on the terminal output provided. What do you see? What has been accomplished? What still needs to be done?",
  "plan": "Describe your plan for the next steps. What commands will you run and why? Be specific about what you expect each command to accomplish.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "ls -la\n",
      "duration": 0.1
    },
    {
      "keystrokes": "cd project\n",
      "duration": 0.1
    }
  ],
  "task_complete": true
}

Required fields:
- "analysis": Your analysis of the current situation
- "plan": Your plan for the next steps
- "commands": Array of command objects to execute

Optional fields:
- "task_complete": Boolean indicating if the task is complete (defaults to false if not present)

Command object structure:
- "keystrokes": String containing the exact keystrokes to send to the terminal (required)
- "duration": Number of seconds to wait for the command to complete before the next command will be executed (defaults to 1.0 if not present)

IMPORTANT: The text inside "keystrokes" will be used completely verbatim as keystrokes. Write commands exactly as you want them sent to the terminal:
- You must end every command with a newline (\n) or it will not execute.
- For special key sequences, use tmux-style escape sequences:
  - C-c for Ctrl+C
  - C-d for Ctrl+D

The "duration" attribute specifies the number of seconds to wait for the command to complete (default: 1.0) before the next command will be executed. On immediate tasks (e.g., cd, ls, echo, cat) set a duration of 0.1 seconds. On commands (e.g., gcc, find, rustc) set a duration of 1.0 seconds. On slow commands (e.g., make, python3 [long running script], wget [file]) set an appropriate duration as you determine necessary.

It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. It is always possible to wait again if the prior output has not finished, by running {"keystrokes": "", "duration": 10.0} on subsequent requests to wait longer. Never wait longer than 60 seconds; prefer to poll to see intermediate result status.

Important notes:
- Each command's keystrokes are sent exactly as written to the terminal
- Do not include extra whitespace before or after the keystrokes unless it's part of the intended command
- Extra text before or after the JSON will generate warnings but be tolerated
- The JSON must be valid - use proper escaping for quotes and special characters within strings
- Commands array can be empty if you want to wait without taking action

Task Description:
Build a complete ML model serving platform as a single Go binary. The platform is an HTTP gateway (default port 9090) that manages model artifacts, serves real-time and batch inference requests, and provides authentication with role-based access, metrics collection, audit logging, and webhook notifications. All state persists to disk as JSON files under `/app/data/` and survives restarts.

## Model Registry

Models are versioned artifacts identified by a unique name. Each model carries:

- One or more versions following semantic versioning (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH).
- Metadata fields: `framework` (one of `tensorflow`, `pytorch`, `onnx`, `custom`), `description`, `author`, creation timestamp.
- `input_schema` and `output_schema` as JSON Schema objects (stored but validated structurally — keys, required fields, types).
- Arbitrary string key-value `labels`.
- Lineage: `training_dataset` name, `parent_model` name (for fine-tuned models), `training_metrics` as string-to-float key-value pairs (e.g. `{"accuracy": 0.94, "f1": 0.91}`).
- Each version has an independent deployment status: `undeployed` (default), `deploying`, `deployed`, `failed`.

Endpoints:

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| POST | `/api/v1/models` | Register model. JSON body: `name`, `framework`, `description`, `author`, `input_schema`, `output_schema`, `labels`, `lineage`. Returns created model with generated UUID `id`. |
| GET | `/api/v1/models` | List models. Query params: `name` (substring), `framework` (exact), `label_key`+`label_value` (filter by label), `deployed` (`true`/`false` — has any deployed version). |
| GET | `/api/v1/models/{id}` | Full model details with all versions. |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/models/{id}` | Delete model and all versions. Reject with 409 if any version is deployed. |
| POST | `/api/v1/models/{id}/versions` | Upload new version. Multipart form: `version` (semver), `binary` (model executable file), `release_notes` (optional). Stores binary on disk. |
| GET | `/api/v1/models/{id}/versions` | List versions for a model. |
| GET | `/api/v1/models/{id}/versions/{version}/download` | Download model binary. |
| POST | `/api/v1/models/{id}/versions/{version}/deploy` | Deploy version. Only one version per model can be deployed — deploying a new one auto-undeploys the current. |
| POST | `/api/v1/models/{id}/versions/{version}/undeploy` | Undeploy version. |

## Inference Engine

Only deployed models serve inference. A model binary is an executable file: it reads a JSON object from stdin and writes a JSON result object to stdout.

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| POST | `/api/v1/infer/{model_name}` | Single inference. JSON body is the model input. Gateway finds the deployed version, executes the binary, returns `{"model": name, "version": ver, "latency_ms": N, "timestamp": ISO8601, "result": <model_output>}`. Timeout: configurable (default 30 s). |
| POST | `/api/v1/infer/{model_name}/batch` | Batch inference. Body: `{"inputs": [...]}`. Runs the model once per input. Returns `{"model": name, "version": ver, "results": [...], "errors": [...]}`. Each entry is either the result or an error string. |

If the model binary exits non-zero or times out, return HTTP 500 with a JSON error.

## Authentication & Authorization

API key authentication with three roles: `admin`, `deployer`, `viewer`.

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| POST | `/api/v1/auth/register` | Create user. Body: `username`, `password`, `role`. First registered user auto-promotes to `admin`. Subsequent user creation requires admin auth. |
| POST | `/api/v1/auth/login` | Login. Body: `username`, `password`. Returns `{"api_key": "<token>", "role": "<role>"}`. |

All other endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

| Role | Permissions |
|------|-------------|
| `viewer` | All GET endpoints |
| `deployer` | Viewer + all model, version, deploy, infer mutations |
| `admin` | Deployer + user management, webhooks, admin/metrics, admin/config, admin/audit |

Return 401 for missing/invalid token, 403 for insufficient role.

## Metrics, Audit & Webhooks

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| GET | `/api/v1/admin/metrics` | System metrics: `total_models`, `deployed_models`, `total_inferences`, `avg_inference_latency_ms`, `inferences_per_model` (map), `error_count`, `uptime_seconds`. |
| GET | `/api/v1/admin/audit` | Last 1000 audit entries. Entry: `timestamp`, `user`, `action`, `resource_type`, `resource_id`, `details`, `source_ip`. |
| POST | `/api/v1/webhooks` | Register webhook. Body: `url`, `events` (from: `model.created`, `model.deleted`, `version.uploaded`, `version.deployed`, `version.undeployed`, `inference.completed`). |
| GET | `/api/v1/webhooks` | List webhooks. |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/webhooks/{id}` | Delete webhook. |

All mutating operations generate audit entries. Webhook delivery: POST JSON `{"event": E, "timestamp": T, "data": {...}}` to registered URLs (fire-and-forget, 5 s timeout).

## Configuration

Read from `/app/data/config.json` at startup:

```json
{
  "port": 9090,
  "data_dir": "/app/data",
  "model_storage_dir": "/app/data/models",
  "inference_timeout_sec": 30,
  "max_batch_size": 100,
  "log_level": "info",
  "webhook_timeout_sec": 5,
  "metrics_retention_hours": 24,
  "max_model_size_mb": 500
}
```

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| GET | `/api/v1/admin/config` | Current config. |
| POST | `/api/v1/admin/config` | Partial update. Port changes require restart. |

## Health & Startup

- `GET /api/v1/health` — `{"status": "healthy", "uptime_seconds": N}` (no auth required).
- On startup: create data directories, load config, restore persisted state, start HTTP server.
- Graceful shutdown on SIGTERM/SIGINT.

func (s *Server) Routes() http.Handler {
    mux := http.NewServeMux()

    mux.HandleFunc("POST /api/v1/auth/login", s.Login)

    mux.HandleFunc("POST /api/v1/models/{id}/versions", s.UploadVersion)
    mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/v1/models/{id}/versions", s.ListVersions)
    mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/v1/models/{id}/versions/{version}/download", s.DownloadVersion)
    mux.HandleFunc("POST /api/v1/models/{id}/versions/{version}/deploy", s.DeployVersion)
    mux.HandleFunc("POST /api/v1/models/{id}/versions/{version}/undeploy", s.UndeployVersion)

package main

import (
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "log"
    "net/http"
    "os"
    "os/signal"
    "syscall"
    "time"

    "mlgateway/internal/audit"
    "mlgateway/internal/auth"
    "mlgateway/internal/config"
    "mlgateway/internal/inference"
    "mlgateway/internal/metrics"
    "mlgateway/internal/registry"
    "mlgateway/internal/server"
    "mlgateway/internal/store"
    "mlgateway/internal/webhooks"
)

func main() {
    startTime := time.Now()

    cfgPath := "/app/data/config.json"
    cfg, err := config.Load(cfgPath)
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatalf("config: %v", err)
    }

    if err := os.MkdirAll(cfg.DataDir, 0755); err != nil {
        log.Fatalf("data dir: %v", err)
    }
    if err := os.MkdirAll(cfg.ModelStorageDir, 0755); err != nil {
        log.Fatalf("model storage dir: %v", err)
    }

    st, err := store.New(cfg.DataDir)
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatalf("store: %v", err)
    }

    as := auth.New(st)
    rs := registry.New(st, cfg.ModelStorageDir, cfg.MaxModelSizeMB)
    is := inference.New(rs, cfg.InferenceTimeoutSec)
    ms := metrics.New(st, startTime)
    aus := audit.New(st)
    ws := webhooks.New(st, cfg.WebhookTimeoutSec)

    srv := server.New(cfg, st, as, rs, is, ms, aus, ws, startTime)

    httpServer := &http.Server{
        Addr:    fmt.Sprintf(":%d", cfg.Port),
        Handler: srv.Routes(),
    }

    serverErrors := make(chan error, 1)
    go func() {
        log.Printf("listening on :%d", cfg.Port)
        serverErrors <- httpServer.ListenAndServe()
    }()

    shutdown := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
    signal.Notify(shutdown, syscall.SIGTERM, syscall.SIGINT)

    select {
    case err := <-serverErrors:
        if err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
            log.Fatalf("server: %v", err)
        }
    case <-shutdown:
        log.Printf("shutting down")
        ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
        defer cancel()
        _ = httpServer.Shutdown(ctx)
    }
}
EOF
